correctness.rationale: For every finite forest F and nonempty marked A, contracting the c components of F[A] and adjoining external vertices with at least two marked neighbors produces a bipartite forest. Its edge budget is \(\sum_{w\in W}(d_A(w)-1)\leq c-1\). Each nontrivial marked-tree component contributes at most s−2 marked vertices with two or more marked neighbors. Adding one empty, m singleton, external and internal multi-trace possibilities gives \(2m-t\). Equality requires t=0 and \(m-1\) external degree-two vertices yielding a spanning tree of marked parameters; every extremal labelled family is distinct, and the minimal host requires m singleton witnesses plus \(m-1\) doubleton witnesses. Full proof in RESULT.md, with reproducible independent finite-case enumeration in CHECK.py.
